source.title: Derry Journal, 19 May 1961, p. 10 ("Contests for two Derry County Council seats")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: printed in the Derry Journal's list of 'The uncontested seats' after nominations closed (Derry Journal, 19 May 1961)

note: Polled 1 June 1961: the Limavady Rural District notice of election (Derry Journal, 5 May 1961) fixes 'the day of Election' as Thursday 1 June 1961, and the county results were 'announced early this morning' in the Belfast News-Letter of 2 June 1961. Faughanvale and Dungiven were the only contested seats; the other seventeen members were returned unopposed, and sixteen of them are named in the Derry Journal's list of uncontested seats; the seventeenth, Moneymore, is supplied from the returning officer's official result notice of 6 June 1961. Returned unopposed.
